name: Wild Apes
summary: Wild Apes is a fast-paced VR tag game where you swing, climb, and leap through untamed environments as a wild ape. Outsmart your friends, master the jungle, and see who can survive the chase! Explore dense forests, scale towering cliffs, and use your agility to evade capture or hunt down your prey. With immersive VR movement and chaotic multiplayer action, every match is a test of speed, strategy, and survival.
